scope: Viewport reveal fixes for selected Zotero field context; product changes confined to WordZoteroTransaction reveal/bounds helpers and their imports.
changes: Reveal the exact selected original source range horizontally and vertically; preserve X when already visible.
Match paged canvas content geometry: 64 pixel side gutters, 14 pixel scrollbar, 24 pixel page gaps, points-to-pixels and current zoom.
Clamp with actual viewport extent and remember the legal revealed origin for guarded restoration.
Map note display offsets to exclude generated labels; use TextPainter selection boxes for overlay note text.
Measure unpainted shaped lines with PaintRunText, restoring all fitted line/glyph values in a finally block so incremental layout and renderer fit caches remain unchanged.

commands.result: 105 tests passed, including all 31 selected-context controller tests and five new canvas-backed regressions.

new_regressions: High-zoom selected citation wholly beyond left canvas edge is revealed and original viewport restored.
High-zoom right-aligned citation wholly beyond right canvas edge is revealed and original viewport restored.
Already-visible selected citation preserves horizontal origin at high zoom.
Last-page footnote clamps at the canvas maximum Y, remains fully visible after actual layout/first paint, preserves original layout metrics, and restores original viewport.
Right-aligned overlay note reveals only source citation text beyond its generated label, remains visible after canvas layout, and restores original viewport.
development_findings: First regression run: 29 passed and one new last-footnote test failed horizontal visibility after first paint. Its unpainted engine glyph metrics differed from the canvas metrics. Fixed by reversible PaintRunText measurement; both final runs passed.
An unnecessary services.dart test import was removed after analyzer informational output; final analyzer has no issues.
